architecture.mechanism: Implementing a pre-charge pulse with a high current density to suppress lithium plating on the graphite anode
architecture.intervention: Integrate a 10-20 A pre-charge pulse for 1-2 seconds before the 350 kW fast charge, using a capacitor or a dedicated pre-charge circuit
architecture.expected_effect: Reduces lithium plating on the graphite anode, thereby slowing down capacity fade and extending the battery's lifespan
architecture.falsification_test: Measure the battery's capacity retention after 3000 fast-charge cycles with and without the pre-charge pulse, comparing the results to a baseline test without any intervention
